spec.title: gate A8: the 42 target tasks and the 7 native constructed run paths, run with JBMC absent
spec.description: Gate A8 of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets-acceptance.md requires the new native tasks to run with JBMC absent (its adversarial row: native execution without JBMC installed works for supported tasks, with no hidden mandatory dependency). Every step runs inside examples/tools/targets/without_jbmc.sh, which covers each jbmc executable (on PATH, and in /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin and /bin, the target route's fixed PATH) with /dev/null in a private bwrap mount namespace, and checks before running anything that no jbmc can be run or found (exit 2 otherwise). Inside it: all 42 tasks of the seven target sidecar examples (105, 285, 286, 287, 305, 306, 307) at this commit. The 14 replays and 105's three proof tasks with verdicts go through build.py N --task T, each expected as expected (a replay: its pair's outcomes; 105 fix-property established, fix-property-before refuted, regression refuted, as their last jobs gave). The 25 tasks blocked by an observed gap (VF-027, VF-028) go through workflow_refusal.py N T, each expected to stop at its recorded refusal under its recorded claim key. Then one constructed example per native run path of build.py (144, 145, 149, 151, 161, 172, 190), each expected to give its recorded verdict. No outputs are applied back: each step's line in the log is the evidence. A step that fails because jbmc is missing is a hidden dependency, a finding for A8.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: without_jbmc.sh prints 'JBMC absent' before each; the 17 build.py --task steps print 'as expected'; the 25 workflow_refusal.py steps print 'refused as predicted'; the 7 constructed examples print '(as expected)'. A NOT AS EXPECTED, a NOT AS PREDICTED, or any failure that names jbmc fails A8

resources.notes: the sum of these tasks' last jobs (105 regression 281 s and confined-change 263 s, four 122 s refusals, the rest 2-54 s each) is about 22 minutes, peak 0.89 GB; the seven constructed examples take seconds each
